profile.headline: Software Engineer at American Express
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Hi, My name is Devonne Walker! My journey to becoming a software engineer started with my previous role as a digital marketing strategist. Within that role-outside of building campaigns, and collecting and analyzing website metrics such as bounce rate and traffic sources-I began trying my hand at rebuilding the company's WordPress website, which gave me a crash course in CSS and HTML. Following that, I applied and got accepted into Fullstack Academy to continue learning about software engineering. During my time at Fullstack Academy, I was placed on two teams, one where we created an E-commerce platform, and the second team we created an online multiplayer card game clone with a fully functioning chatroom. Working within these teams helped me build the skills that every engineer needs to become a great engineer, communication, and teamwork. Beyond software engineering I do enjoy cooking and photography, it gives me a creative outlet that I can share with others.

positions.title: Teaching Fellow
positions.description:
• Taught JavaScript, software development concepts, and the PERN stack to cohort of 40+ students
• Managed 4 students projects from ideation to deployment as team manager, technical mentor, and code reviewer
• Conducted technical interviews for prospective students in JavaScript twice weekly
• Mentored students one-on-one to help them understand JavaScript fundamentals, debug, and problem-solve while completing bootcamp
• Led weekly technical interview prep for senior students in data structures and algorithms

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialst
positions.description:
Content strategy and production of photo, video and editorial content for DNYC’s digital platforms and social media accounts to support all endeavors- new products, education, and sublines.

Collaborate with influencers to strategize and produce branded content to seamlessly integrate with our brand

Evaluated the effectiveness of campaigns in order to inform future media and creative strategies

Optimized effectiveness and maximize return on investment with strategic buys
